description: A data pack's functions, predicates, item modifiers and loot tables: load and tick function tags, macros (inline and with storage), recursion, return values and return fail, execute if function, function tags, schedule (replace, append, clear), predicates by id and their random draws, an item modifier with random enchanting, a loot table with every entry type and its random sequence, then /reload and datapack disable/enable re-running the load function.
